invite.title: Pair a device
invite.step1: On the other device, open Territories: Sync and pairing → QR code.

invite.step3: Confirm here. From then on, both sync by themselves.

invite.qrAlt: Pairing code for the other device

tip.wifiOn: Turn on Wi-Fi or plug in a network cable.
tip.sameWifi: Put both on the same network: the same Wi-Fi, or by cable on the same router.
tip.guest: Guest Wi-Fi often keeps devices apart. Use the normal one.
tip.hotspot: No Wi-Fi? Turn on a phone’s hotspot and connect the other device to it. To sync later, you’ll need the hotspot again, or a shared Wi-Fi.
tip.firewall: On Windows, allow Territories when the firewall asks.
tip.localNetwork: iPhone: Settings → Territories → turn on Local Network.
tip.vpn: Using a VPN? Turn it off for a moment.
tip.code: Check the 6 digits on the other device, or scan the QR code instead.
tip.cable: On a cable? It has to be plugged into the router that makes the Wi-Fi.
